text:
emma: Starting the publish window for Python + TS SDKs. Canaries are queued, want a quick pre-cut checklist. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canaries launched: py-canary-2026-03-21-a (replicas 2), ts-canary-2026-03-21-a (replicas 2). CI: https://ci/internal/6721
raj: Rollback signal we agreed on: >0.5% client error rate, signer mismatch on wheels, or checksum mismatch. If triggered, pin `latest` back to previous tag and open a rollback PR.
marta: Also watch typedef drift for TS; generator changes have bitten us before. If types break, we hold GA and republish canary after fix.
ken: Publish checklist: 1) push artifacts to staging registry 2) smoke `pip install redwood-sdk==canary` and `npm i @redwood/sdk@canary` 3) run sample-app smoke 4) verify telemetry/usage trends.
paul: Running smoke installs now. Py passes install, TS install throws a types error around `ClientOptions.timeout` in generated types. Investigating. :mag:
emma: If typedef break is confirmed, we should hold GA. No emergency hotfixes during window unless it's blocking. Decide in +10m.
sre-oncall: CI infra reports increased queue times; flaky integ tests should be retried once before deeming failure. Incident: https://infra/inc/8892
raj: Rollback mechanics: pin `latest` to `2026-03-19-stable` and create `canary-hold` dist-tag for troubleshooting. Update release notes draft to indicate hold reason.
paul: Found the bug in the typedef generator diff. Can patch and republish canary quickly. Prefer republish over rollback.
emma: Agreed, republish canary. If patched canary passes installs + telemetry in 15m, we'll proceed to GA cut.
deploy-bot: py-canary: smoke ok. ts-canary: smoke failed (typedef error).
marta: Hold GA. @paul can you push a patched canary and confirm artifact URL? Also mark release notes with "hold: TS typedef" and guidance for consumers who pinned types.
paul: Patched and published ts-canary-2026-03-21-b. Artifact: registry.corp/npm/@redwood/sdk/ts-canary-b
ken: Re-running smoke installs and sample-app tests.
paul: TS canary install + runtime smoke pass.
raj: Telemetry check: no anomalous token errors in the 5m after republish. Good to proceed in 5m.
emma: I'll coordinate GA cut. Reminder: add migration note for `ClientOptions.timeout` and a compatibility note for pinned type users. Also recommend pinning strategies for customers.
sre-oncall: No infra alerts. Proceeding.
deploy-bot: Starting GA publish jobs: publish-py-2026-03-21, publish-ts-2026-03-21. Logs: https://ci/internal/publish/9812
paul: Please include a short section in release notes about checksum verification steps we ran during the window so customers can reproduce verification.
emma: Added that to the draft: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-21-sdk-release (draft).
raj: Post-GA action: create a brief RCA for the typedef regression and add a regression test to the generator. Assigning to @paul and @marta.
paul: Will raise PR for generator test and patch.
marta: Finalizing release notes and will post announcement to #announcements at 16:30 UTC. :tada:
emma: Closing thread unless rollback criteria hit in next 30m (monitoring for >1% error increase or any checksum/signature alerts). Thanks all.
deploy-bot: Publish jobs completed: success. Artifacts pinned: py@2026-03-21, ts@2026-03-21. :shipit:
